title: Open Soil Spectral Library
text:
Welcome!
Welcome to the Open Soil Spectral Library (OSSL) manual!
The OSSL is a public and growing dataset that is compiled by the Soil Spectroscopy for Global Good initiative.
A peer-reviewed and open-access publication is available for additional reference.
Please navigate to the different sections to learn more about:

📘 About: Our team, OSSL resources, contributors, citation, and other information.
📘 Soil Spectroscopy: Soil spectroscopy in general, predictive modeling, imported soil spectral libraries, instruments and software.
📘 Database description: Database definitions, including variable names, types, human-readable description, and example values.
📘 Database access: Ways of accessing the OSSL.
📘 Neospectra database: Data, models, and studies from a low-cost NIR scanner.
📘 Predictive models: Fitted models with the OSSL.
📘 Web services: User-friendly and online applications.
📘 Hands-on tutorial: Training materials.
📘 Scientific publications: Papers that our team or collaborators have published.
📘 References.

title: 3  BESB
text:
3.1 ICRAF.ISRIC
A Globally Distributed Soil Spectral Library. VisNIR and MIR measurements for some 785 profiles from the ISRIC World Soil Reference Collection. The samples are from 58 countries spanning Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, and South America.
